scenarios.description: The real brain: a question, a held turn, an insult, a joke.
scenarios.name: smoke-brain
scenarios.state: Everyday chat with Alex, someone she likes; he gets snappy once, then tells a joke.

steps.rubric: Waits through "hold on", then answers the question.
Says calmly, once, that she doesn't like that; no apology, no grovelling.
Laughs or groans at the punchline; no joke of her own.
